analysis.summary: One Global Service Provider Limited released its 33rd Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting strategic expansion into IT consultancy and software solutions alongside its core healthcare and life sciences business. The company reported total revenue of Rs. 14,784.17 lakhs and a net profit of Rs. 1,846.66 lakhs for the year, bolstered by an approved scheme of amalgamation with Plus Care Internationals Private Limited. Management emphasized a commitment to making quality healthcare accessible and affordable through digital platforms while maintaining robust internal controls and corporate governance standards.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence that the company will grow and achieve success in the market despite a non-remarkable beginning phase in the IT consultancy and software solutions sector.
guidance.quote: In the beginning phase, the performance of the Company is not remarkable but I am sure we will grow and achieve the success the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the initial performance in the new IT segment is modest but expressed confidence in achieving sustainable growth and market success.
demand_outlook.quote: While our initial performance in this new segment is modest, we are confident that with perseverance, innovation, and strategic partnerships, we will achieve sustainable growth and market success.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently expanded its object and entered the IT consultancy and software solutions industry.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has recently expanded its Object and also entered in the industry of IT Consultancy and Software Solutions provider.

capex_expansion.claim: Pluscare Internationals Private Limited is planning to get merged with the company, and documents have been filed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
capex_expansion.quote: Pluscare Internationals Private Limited is planning to get merged with the company and the company has filed documents on the Bombay Stock Exchange.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has not recommended any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 1 per share on equity shares for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on the Company’s performance, the Board recommended a dividend of ` Rs. 1 per share on 71,04,707 equity shares of ` 10 each, subject to the approval of the Members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of the Company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of the Company did not recommend any dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: There has been no transfers to the General Reserve of the Company for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: There has been no transfers to the General Reserve of the Company for the year under review.

management_commitments.claim: If physical security holders fail to furnish PAN, KYC and nomination details before the due date, the company is obligated to freeze such folios.
management_commitments.quote: In case a holder of physical securities fails to furnish these details before the due date, the Company is obligated to freeze such folios.

management_commitments.claim: If frozen securities continue to remain so as on December 31, 2025, the company shall refer them to the administering authority under applicable acts.
management_commitments.quote: If the securities continue to remain frozen as on December 31, 2025, the Company shall refer such securities to the administering authority under the Benami Transactions (Prohibitions) Act, 1988, and / or the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002.

management_commitments.claim: The company is awaiting a No Objection Certificate from the Bombay Stock Exchange for the further process of its merger with Pluscare Internationals Private Limited.
management_commitments.quote: The company is awaited to receive No Objection Certificate from the Bombay Stock Exchange for the further process of merger.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
